relationships.subject: spinal microglia
relationships.evidence_quote: We observed that the acute itch responses to histamine, compound 48/80 and chloroquine were all significantly reduced in mice with either whole or central depletion.

relationships.subject: CX3CL1-CX3CR1 pathway
relationships.evidence_quote: histamine and compound 48/80, but not chloroquine elicited primary itch signal transmission from DRG to spinal Npr1- and somatostatin-positive neurons relied on microglial CX3CL1-CX3CR1 pathway

key_findings: Microglia depletion reduced itch responses to histamine, compound 48/80 and chloroquine.
Histamine-dependent but not chloroquine itch requires microglial CX3CL1-CX3CR1 signaling.
